contract.core.main_02.description: Watch the market while hauling, and feel how weight changes speed.

contract.core.normal_passenger.descripti: A few passengers on a short route.
contract.core.normal_urgent.name: Urgent Cargo
event.core.boiler_overheat.name: Boiler Overheat
event.core.boiler_overheat.description: The pressure gauge crosses the red line and the boiler shrieks.
event.core.boiler_overheat.water_cooling: Use fresh water for emergency cooling
event.core.boiler_overheat.paid_repair: Pay overtime for an emergency repair
event.core.merchant_intel.name: Merchant Encounter
event.core.merchant_intel.description: A merchant ship offers freshly gathered market intelligence.
notice.core.overheat.cooled: Water floods the boiler and pressure falls back.
notice.core.overheat.repaired: The ship stops in calm water for repairs. The voyage is delayed.
notice.core.overheat.paid: The crew works overtime and the boiler stabilises.
notice.core.overheat.forced: You press on. The hull takes extra damage.
notice.core.overheat.jettisoned: Some ordinary cargo goes overboard, lightening the ship.
notice.core.merchant.bought: The merchant hands over a fresh market and heading report.
notice.core.merchant.declined: The merchant folds the charts and turns away.
story.core.opening.title: Day One — Iron Harbour
story.core.opening.body.1: You wake on the Iron Harbour docks with no ship and no coin.
story.core.opening.body.2: An old shipwright presses a rusty key into your hand: "The boiler still burns. Get her supplies before she dies on you."
story.core.supply_brief.title: Making Ready
story.core.supply_brief.body.1: Open the Supply page and buy 2 coal and 2 fresh water. The harbour clerk will talk charts and papers once she is provisioned.
story.core.supply_brief.objective: Buy 2 coal for the ship (Supply page)
story.core.chart_brief.title: The Chart Unsealed
story.core.chart_brief.body.1: The harbour clerk reads your contract and slaps a chart on the table. Your destination is already marked — open the chart and check the route.
story.core.chart_brief.objective: Open the chart and review the destination
story.core.depart_brief.title: First Voyage
story.core.depart_brief.body.1: The contract is on a clock. Select the destination on the chart and confirm departure; with little time to spare, choose the Fast boiler strategy.
story.core.depart_brief.objective: Depart from the chart for the destination
story.core.chapter_wrap.title: First Voyage Complete
story.core.chapter_wrap.body.1: You reached the neighbouring harbour. Chapter one of the tutorial ends here; later chapters arrive in the next build. For now, explore freely.
